title: Asteroid Collision
statement: Each value is an asteroid: the magnitude is its size and the sign is its direction, positive for right and negative for left. All move at the same speed. When two meet, the smaller explodes; if they are the same size both explode. Asteroids moving the same way, or apart, never meet. Return the state once everything has settled.
constraints: a collision happens only when a right-mover is immediately followed by a left-mover
hints: A collision needs a positive asteroid on the left and a negative one on the right. Two negatives, two positives, or a negative then a positive all pass by untouched.
Keep the survivors on a stack. A new left-mover has to fight the right-movers on top until one of them wins or it is destroyed.

Three outcomes per fight and they are easy to muddle: the stack top is smaller so it pops and the fight continues; sizes are equal so both die; the top is bigger so the newcomer dies. Only the case where the newcomer survives every fight lets it get pushed.

cases.name: one right-mover destroyed, the rest pass
a left-mover survives to the far left
